posts.text: I was in New Mexico this weekend and had some time to ask my friend @Deb Haaland a few fun questions… #fyp
THANK YOU, Albuquerque, NM for having me at your No Kings rally today. So much energy and so many people saying loud and clear: NO KINGS 🚫👑 #fyp #nokings

The war in Iran continues to rage on and the American people still don’t have any answers as to what the plan even is. Join me and @Mehdi Hasan this week on our podcast Assembly Required to hear more. Tune in at the link in my bio or wherever you get your podcasts #fyp #politics

Trump's pressure campaign against Anthropic shows we are entering a future where the government could harness the power of AI against its own people. I wrote about this and more on my Substack, Assembly Notes. Subscribe at the link in my bio! #fyp #ai #politics
Head to my Substack at the link in bio for the full conversation with Joseph Gordon-Levitt about movies, faith, AI, and much more 🔗  #faith #fyp
